container.definition:
Bootstrap: docker
From: rockylinux:9

%post
    dnf install -y --setopt=install_weak_deps=False gcc mpich mpich-devel && dnf clean all
    mkdir -p /opt/mpi
    printf '%s\n' \
        '#include <mpi.h>' \
        '#include <stdio.h>' \
        'int main(int argc, char **argv) {' \
        '    int rank, size, len, sum = 0, expected;' \
        '    char name[MPI_MAX_PROCESSOR_NAME];' \
        '    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);' \
        '    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);' \
        '    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);' \
        '    MPI_Get_processor_name(name, &len);' \
        '    printf("Hello from rank %d of %d on %s\n", rank, size, name);' \
        '    MPI_Allreduce(&rank, &sum, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_SUM, MPI_COMM_WORLD);' \
        '    expected = size * (size - 1) / 2;' \
        '    if (rank == 0) printf("Allreduce of the ranks: %d (expected %d): %s\n", sum, expected, sum == expected ? "OK" : "WRONG");' \
        '    MPI_Finalize();' \
        '    return sum == expected ? 0 : 1;' \
        '}' > /opt/mpi/mpi_hello.c
    export PATH=/usr/lib64/mpich/bin:$PATH
    mpicc -O2 -o /opt/mpi/mpi_hello /opt/mpi/mpi_hello.c

%environment
    export PATH=/usr/lib64/mpich/bin:$PATH

%runscript
    exec mpirun -np 2 /opt/mpi/mpi_hello

%test
    mpirun -np 2 /opt/mpi/mpi_hello
